item.title: Indiana sets record 92% graduation rate in 2025; IPS hits 93%
item.description: The Indiana Department of Education reported a record high 92% graduation rate for the class of 2025, with Indianapolis Public Schools exceeding the state average at 93%. An IPS leader credited early intervention and the monitoring of student progress.

item.title: Hoosiers’ Lamar Wilkerson scores 24 points in win over Maryland
item.description: Indiana defeated Maryland 84-66 on Wednesday night, with Lamar Wilkerson scoring 24 points, including 16 of Indiana's points in a key second-half run.

item.title: Braden Smith’s free throws seal No. 5 Purdue’s victory against Washington
item.description: No. 5 Purdue defeated Washington 81-73, with Braden Smith leading the way with 23 points and 7 assists, while Trey Kaufman-Renn added 14 points and 14 rebounds.

item.title: Auto parts facility in Warsaw to close, affecting 262 workers
item.description: First Brands Group is set to permanently close its Dalton Corp. Warsaw Manufacturing Facility next month, impacting 262 employees.

item.title: Wabash National to close Goshen facility, affecting 144 workers
item.description: Wabash National Services will close its Goshen, Indiana, manufacturing facility, resulting in the permanent layoff of 144 workers starting on March 6.

item.title: Driver ‘failed to realize road had ended’ before fatal Huntington County crash
item.description: A 77-year-old Bluffton man died after his SUV went airborne and flipped several times while driving on I-69 in Huntington County, Indiana.
